known_limits: Selected official numerical functions only, not whole-paper benchmarks or model training.
Provided vectors are explicit synthetic tests, not generated model embeddings.
q=0 explicitly deferred for the preserved upstream numerical-rank issue; no source algorithm repair.

No local model packages installed/called, no GPU use; import guard is not a general security sandbox.
